name: kenning
displayName: Kenning — Understand the code your AI writes
description: While Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any coding agent works, Kenning turns its changes into quick review cards: what changed, risky edits flagged, one quick question — and a one-click flag the agent fixes before it finishes.

enumDescriptions: Use Claude Code if it is installed, otherwise an Anthropic API key if one is set.
Use your local Claude Code (your plan, nothing extra to configure).
Use an Anthropic API key (set it with “Kenning: Set Anthropic API key”).
No AI: cards show the change and risk flags, and you mark them as understood.
kenning.ai.provider.description: Where Kenning gets plain-English summaries and quick questions about each change.

kenning.ai.model.description: Model used for summaries and questions.

kenning.ai.prefetch.description: How many upcoming cards to prepare in advance while the agent works.

kenning.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code executable.

kenning.watchExternalChanges.description: Create cards for files changed outside the editor (Codex, Aider, Copilot agent, scripts). Git operations such as checkout are ignored.

kenning.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when the agent finishes and changes are waiting.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Kenning
walkthroughs.description: Understand every change your AI agent makes, while it works.

steps.title: Connect your agent
steps.description:
Kenning plugs into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor with a few small, personal hooks.
[Connect Claude Code](command:kenning.connectClaude)
[Connect another agent](command:kenning.connectAgent)

steps.title: Review while your agent works
steps.description:
Every change becomes a card: what changed, what looks risky, and one quick question. Answer with 1–4.
[Open Kenning](command:kenning.focus)

media.altText: A Kenning card showing a highlighted diff, a summary and a quick question

steps.title: Flag it, and the agent fixes it
steps.description: Press F on a card, say what is wrong, and Claude addresses it before it finishes.

steps.title: Open the full review
steps.description:
Need more room? Open the review in an editor tab: every changed file in a list, side-by-side diffs, the whole file around each change, and your history.
[Open full review](command:kenning.openPanel)

steps.title: Using Copilot, Aider or a script?
steps.description:
Agents without hooks work too, with nothing to set up.
[Review uncommitted changes](command:kenning.reviewUncommitted)

steps.title: Share your score
steps.description: Click “Share today” under your score to save an image of how much of today’s AI code you understood.

media.altText: A share card: Of the code my AI wrote today, I truly understood 86%

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && KENNING_E2E=1 vitest run test/e2e.test.ts
